newsitem.title: USA: Nabisco to sell four regional brands.
newsitem.headline: Nabisco to sell four regional brands.

text.p: Nabisco Inc said on Monday it planned to sell four of its regional brands, which had combined sales of $29 million in 1995, as part of its ongoing restructuring process.
The brands, all managed by Specialty Products Co, an operating company of Nabisco, were Regina Vinegars and Cooking Wines, Wright's Liquid Smoke, Brer Rabbit Molasses and Vermont Maid Syrups.

"Each one of these brands is profitable and has a strong and loyal consumer base," said Nabisco President and Chief Executive Officer H. John Greeniaus. "While they don't fit with our focus on national market category leadership, we are confident that a number of potential buyers will find them highly attractive."
On June 24, Nabisco sait it would restructure its operations in order to cut costs.
